items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Is that the young Willie Umfrey? His father was named Willie too.

ctx.x: Yes, I worked there too. Well, and Willie Umfrey. Do you know him?
Is that the young Willie Umfrey? His father was named Willie too.
Yes, but the father was a father. We used to call him Little Belly. He was so fat, you know. They both play clarinet. Yes.
